text: The Free path usually includes about 12 story turns a day.
notes: Use until the live counter and reset schedule are verified; ‘about’ avoids a false exact promise.

text: Your Free story allowance refreshes each day.
evidence_status: EVIDENCED founder input; INPUT REQUIRED reset time
notes: Add a reset time only after product configuration is verified.

text: You can keep reading past turns without using a new turn.
notes: Ship only if rereading truly consumes no allowance.

text: You have {remaining} Free story turns left today.
notes: Interpolate only from the authoritative live cap counter.

text: {remaining} Free turns remain until your daily refresh.
evidence_status: INPUT REQUIRED live counter and reset
notes: Do not show if refresh timing is uncertain.

text: One Free story turn remains today.
notes: Singular variant.

text: This choice uses one Free story turn.
notes: Show before submission only if every successful choice costs exactly one.

text: You have used today’s Free story turns.
evidence_status: EVIDENCED founder cap shape; INPUT REQUIRED counter
notes: Neutral, non-punitive wording.

text: Your Free turns refresh at {reset_time}.
notes: Never guess the time zone.

text: You can return after the daily refresh and continue this story.
notes: Use only if the story is saved through the refresh.

text: Your story is saved. New Free turns arrive with the daily refresh.
notes: Do not claim saved state without verification.

text: Opening setup does not use one of your story turns.
notes: Player cap statement only; provider inference may still cost the service.

text: Your new game opens before the daily story count begins.
notes: Use if the counter visibly starts after setup.

text: A new game adds eight text turns once for its opening run.
notes: Confirm exact eligibility and whether these expire before shipping.

text: This new game includes eight extra opening turns.
notes: Short variant; do not imply every restart earns an unlimited repeat.

text: Eight opening turns were added for this new game.
notes: Confirmation after the one-time hook.

text: The one-time opening bonus has already been used for this game.
evidence_status: EVIDENCED founder input; INPUT REQUIRED tracking
notes: Use only when the durable game flag confirms prior use.

text: That turn did not finish, so it was returned to your allowance.
notes: Do not mention provider billing.

text: No story result arrived. Your turn was not used.
notes: Use only for a confirmed no-result failure.

text: We could not finish that turn. You can try again without losing it.
notes: Fair retry copy.

text: Your turn is back. The story remains at the last completed moment.
evidence_status: EVIDENCED cap rule; SPECULATIVE scene persistence
notes: Second sentence requires verified restore behaviour.

text: That turn got stuck, so we gave it back to you.
notes: Softened Kid Mode variant.

text: Nothing changed, and your turn is still available.
notes: Use only if no state change is guaranteed.

text: Memorable images are off by default.
notes: Plain default-state wording.

text: The Free path does not include a weekly memorable image.
notes: Matches memorable/week 0.

text: Your story continues in text; no image is generated automatically.
notes: Reinforces text-first experience.

text: This story stays in words unless a safe image option is available.
notes: Do not show an unavailable image action.

text: If you want more turns, you may choose an optional ad after the scene.
notes: Never show in Kid Mode or mid-action.

text: Optional ad: watch after this scene for {extra_turns} extra turns.
evidence_status: EVIDENCED founder input; INPUT REQUIRED amount
notes: Requires clear amount and consent.

text: No thanks. Your base Free allowance stays the same.
notes: Refusal must not reduce included turns.

text: Ads never appear inside a story action.
notes: Public trust statement must match production behaviour.

text: Ad overflow is optional and is not available in Kid Mode.
notes: Clear audience gate.

text: Watching an ad does not change the story or improve memory.
notes: Ship only if ad systems cannot affect narrative logic.
